comment: Overall impression: The draft provides a strong, coherent and practical reference architecture that successfully connects health-system goals with shared digital capabilities, interoperability, governance and implementation pathways across different levels of country maturity. Its main opportunity for improvement is to make several cross-cutting requirements more architecturally explicit, particularly consent and permissions management, AI/ML lifecycle governance, longitudinal data lifecycle management and safe synchronisation across federated or offline environments.
